perks.name: Ride Together, Die Together
perks.description: When you pick up an Orb of Power, gain a brief period of rapidly decaying damage reduction.
perks.exact:
On Orb of Power Pickup:
Grants Ride Together, Die Together for 3 seconds.
Ride Together, Die Together initially grants 40% [5%] Damage Resist.
Damage Resist scales down to ~30?% with 1.5 seconds left, further reduced to 24?% with 1 second left, decreasing down to 0% over the remaining second.

perks.name: Too Old for This
perks.description: Defeating a powerful combatant with a finisher grants you Special ammo progress and replenishes a small amount of health.
perks.exact:
On Elite+ Finisher:
Restores 32 HP and +16% Special Ammo Progress.

archetype.name: Paragon
archetype.description:
Armor configured for Guardians who prioritize paracausal attunement.

Primary Stat: Super
Secondary Stat: Melee

item.name: Super Font
item.description: Collecting an Orb of Power causes you to gain 1 temporary Armor Charge.
item.exact:
While Armor Charge is active:

+20 | +40 | +50 Super.

item.name: Special Ammo Finder
item.description: Increases the effect of all contributions towards the Special ammo meter.
item.exact:
Special Ammo Finders:
1.25x | 1.4x | 1.5x Ammo Progress Multiplier.

Heavy Ammo Finders:
1.33x | 1.66x | 2x Ammo Progress Multiplier.

item.name: Heavy Ammo Scout
item.description: When you fill your Heavy ammo meter, it also creates smaller bricks of Heavy ammo for your allies.
item.exact:
Upon spawning a Mod-Matching Ammo Brick:
Allies receive a copy of the Ammo Brick.

Ammo Scout Brick Pickup Amounts:
37% | 67% | 100% of a regular Ammo Brick's.

Enhanced Brick Chance is determined by the ally's Weapons Stat.
